t: You're on Poultry, a short street in the City of London, running east from Cheapside between Old Jewry and Mansion House Street, towards Bank Junction. It sits in the historic nucleus and financial centre of modern London. The English composer Arthur Herbert Jackson was born here. He lived only from 1852 to 1881, so his life was short, and he is remembered as a composer. Beyond that I don't have more to tell you, but it's a nice thing to know while the City hurries past.
